programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Wolf totem / Вълчи тотем
programme.desc: In 1967, the Cultural Revolution in China was in full swing. Student Chen Jun, along with his colleagues, arrives from Beijing to educate the Mongol nomads. The party orders the newborn wolves to be killed, but he attaches to them and secretly saves a little wolf and takes care of him. The boss Bao entrusted the army horses to the nomads, but the horses freeze in an ice lake, put there by the wolf pack left without food. The gazelles that the wolves keep are stolen by speculators. The nomads are slowly pushed and losing their land. The wolves were killed. Chen John's wolf is growing and released. Chen Jun wrote a book that became the most read after Mao Zedong's "Little Red Book". / През 1967 година културната революция в Китай е в разгара си. Студентът Чън Джън, заедно със свои колеги, пристига от Пекин, за да образова монголските номади. Партията издава заповед новородените вълчета да бъдат убивани, но той се привързва към тях и тайно спасява малко вълче и се грижи за него. Началникът Бао поверява армейските коне на номадите, но конете замръзват в ледено езеро, вкарани там от вълчата глутница, която е останала без храна. Газелите, които вълците пазят, са откраднати от спекуланти. Полека номадите са изтласкани и губят земите си. Вълците са избити. Вълчето на Чън Джън пораства и е пуснато на свобода. Чън Джън написва книга, която става най-четената след "Малката червена книга" на Мао Дзедун.

programme.desc: We are looking for proof that we are not alone in the universe, but the first meeting with aliens will mean the end of life we ​​know it. Whether it is nice or poorly discussed. / Търсим доказателство, че не сме сами във Вселената, но първата среща с извънземни ще означава край на живота, какъвто го познаваме. programme.title: Telepathian / Телепазарен прозорец
The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: Are the representatives of the races different from the inside? Is it possible for the progress in technology to create a race that is superior to others? The answers point to the future of humanity. / Различни ли са представителите на расите отвътре? Възможно ли е напредъкът в технологиите да създаде раса, която превъзхожда останалите? Отговорите сочат бъдещето на човечеството.

programme.title: With BNT forever / С БНТ завинаги
programme.desc: Dragomir Draganov will welcome viewers in the studio of "With BNT Forever" to tell with his star guests the unforgettable and exciting stories of the great Bulgarian artists and artists. "With BNT forever" is a natural continuation of BNT of 60 and, like it, will remain a reserved territory for memories and rethinking. / Драгомир Драганов ще посреща зрителите в студиото на "С БНТ завинаги", за да разказва заедно със звездните си гости незабравими и вълнуващи истории на големите български артисти и творци. "С БНТ завинаги" е естествено продължение на "БНТ на 60" и също като него ще остане запазена територия за спомени и преосмисляне.

programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. Since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the fall of the financial power of the Italian first -team players and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality, but returns safe steps to the place where it belongs. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serie A postala je sinonim za taktički nogomet. Dugi niz godina talijanski se nogomet svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Europi. Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

Od kolovoza 2024., najtrofejniji i najpopularniji klubovi zemlje kreću u borbu za naslov jesenskog prvaka u prvom dijelu argentinskog prvenstva. Očekuju nas prepune tribine, neizvjesne utakmice i legendarni derbiji koji definiraju identitet južnoameričkog nogometa – od Superclásica između River Platea i Boce Juniors, do vatrenih okršaja regionalnih rivala...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Dugo Selo - Poreč, Package24 Premier League 2025/2026. / Dugo Selo - Poreč, Paket24 Premijer liga 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Handball - Croatian Handball Premier League - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) Handball Premier League is the highest rank of club handball competitions in Croatia. The league is Basic in 1991 under the authority of the Croatian Handball Federation. So far, the 26th season of the Premier League has been played and it is almost incredibly sounding that all the titles have won the Zagreb team, which has performed under several different names over the years. In addition to Zagreb, the NEXE NEXE should be singled out with nine other places won, and formerly the great Metkovic, who has achieved the same success seven times. 12 teams participate in today's format in the league ... / Handball - Croatian Handball Premier League - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Rukometna Premijer liga najviši je rang klupskih rukometnih natjecanja u Hrvatskoj. Liga je osnovna 1991. pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog rukometnog saveza. Do sada je odigrano 26 sezona Premijer lige te gotovo nevjerojatno zvuči podatak da je sve naslove osvojila momčad Zagreba koja je kroz godine nastupala pod više različitih imena. Uz Zagreb treba još izdvojiti i našički Nexe s devet osvojenih drugim mjesta te nekad veliki Metković koji je taj isti uspjeh ostvario sedam puta. U današnjem formatu u ligi sudjeluje 12 momčadi...

programme.title: BSK - Karlovac 1919, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 7th round / BSK - Karlovac 1919, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 7. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Murder track of a long -distance driver - the hunt for Marco M. / Mordspur eines Fernfahrers - Die Jagd nach Marco M.
programme.desc: Between 2003 and 2006, truck driver Marco M. murdered and raped three women and seriously injures another. He is brutal, he randomly chooses his victims. Sometimes he only misused women after their death. Then he disposed of her like Mull. "It was his goal to sexually abuse her. And he didn't care if she was dead - the main thing is that he could use her," says criminal psychologist Dr. Gilda Giebel, and their crime scenes are Koln, Moers, Dillenburg and Kassel, mostly near motorways. It is always in motion, remains undisturbed for a long time. Fruh indicate traces of a truck driver with firm routes. But the different crime scenes in different federal countries make the case more difficult. Instead of working together, the Sokos act separately. The foderal structure hinders the exchange. Data protection also brakes the investigation: the toll system, which records the license plates of all truck drivers, was able to help, but the operating company must not issue the data. Every new crime scene brings new investigators, new files, new questions. Only one thing remains the same: the taster. After the testimony of the only lived victim, a phantom image can be created - but the decisive note is missing. There are further murders. In October 2005, a woman disappears into Dillenburg and is discovered 30 kilometers away in a forest. No useful DNA traces, a connection is not recognized. When a school woman is kidnapped and murdered in Kassel nine months later, movement comes to the case. A DNA comparison shows that the deeds in Kassel, Koln and Moers hang together. But the tider remains a phantom. He is not registered, just a short time later brings the turn: a tiny skin scale at the victim's bra from Dillenburg provides the crucial proof: it is one and the same tater here too. His phantom image from Koln is reversed - this time also in Hesse. Two clues drove to Marco M. - an incomprehensible family man from Haiger in Central Hesse. The man can be arrested without resistance. He admits his actions without emotion: He also does not know why that it just came up. In June 2007, the district court Limburg Marco M., known as "Brummi-M are", sentenced to life imprisonment with a preventive preventive detention. The psychiatric report certifies him full guilt - and extremely high willingness to use violence. / Zwischen 2003 und 2006 ermordet und vergewaltigt Lkw-Fahrer Marco M. drei Frauen und verletzt eine weitere schwer. Er geht brutal vor, seine Opfer wahlt er zufallig. Manchmal missbraucht er die Frauen erst nach ihrem Tod. Danach entsorgt er sie wie Mull. "Es war sein Ziel, sie sexuell zu missbrauchen. Und ihm war es dann egal, ob sie tot war, bewusstlos - Hauptsache, er konnte uber sie verfugen", sagt Kriminalpsychologin Dr. Gilda Giebel.Seine Tatorte sind Koln, Moers, Dillenburg und Kassel, meist nahe Autobahnen. Er ist immer in Bewegung, bleibt lange unbehelligt.Fruh deuten Spuren auf einen Lkw-Fahrer mit festen Routen hin. Doch die verschiedenen Tatorte in unterschiedlichen Bundeslandern erschweren den Fall. Statt zusammenzuarbeiten, agieren die SOKOS getrennt. Die foderale Struktur behindert den Austausch. Auch der Datenschutz bremst die Ermittlungen: Das Mautsystem, welches die Kennzeichen aller Lkw-Fahrer erfasst, konnte helfen, doch die Betreiberfirma darf die Daten nicht herausgeben. Jeder neue Tatort bringt neue Ermittler, neue Akten, neue Fragen. Nur eines bleibt gleich: der Tater.Nach der Aussage des einzigen uberlebenden Opfers kann ein Phantombild erstellt werden - doch der entscheidende Hinweis fehlt. Es kommt zu weiteren Morden. Im Oktober 2005 verschwindet eine Frau in Dillenburg und wird 30 Kilometer entfernt tot in einem Wald entdeckt. Keine brauchbaren DNA-Spuren, ein Zusammenhang wird nicht erkannt. Als neun Monate spater in Kassel eine Schulerin verschleppt und ermordet wird, kommt Bewegung in den Fall. Ein DNA-Abgleich zeigt: Die Taten in Kassel, Koln und Moers hangen zusammen. Doch der Tater bleibt ein Phantom. Er ist nicht registriert.Nur kurze Zeit spater bringt ein Zufall die Wende: Eine winzige Hautschuppe am BH des Opfers aus Dillenburg liefert den entscheidenden Beweis: Es ist auch hier ein und derselbe Tater. Sein Phantombild aus Koln wird erneut veroffentlicht - dieses Mal auch in Hessen. Zwei Hinweise fuhren zu Marco M. - einem unauffalligen Familienvater aus dem mittelhessischen Haiger. Der Mann lasst sich widerstandslos festnehmen. Seine Taten gesteht er emotionslos: Er wisse auch nicht warum, es sei einfach uber ihn gekommen.Im Juni 2007 verurteilt das Landgericht Limburg Marco M., bekannt als "Brummi-Morder", zu lebenslanger Haft mit anschlieSSender Sicherungsverwahrung. Das psychiatrische Gutachten bescheinigt ihm volle Schuldfahigkeit - und eine extrem hohe Gewaltbereitschaft.

programme.title: cultural Monday / kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: cultural Monday / kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: Sugar - Vater des Italo -blues / Zucchero - Vater des Italo-Blues
programme.desc: The film is a portrait of the legendary Italian singer, multi-instrumentalist Songwriters and Blues musicians Zucchero, which shows the exclusive footage from its private archives and its world tour and lets know well-known companions such as Bono, Sting and Andrea Bocelli. They all report on a man who impressed them both as an artist and as a human being. The documentary is paid by Zucchero's childhood experiences, its persistence, international success, its strong and the years of depression that he had to overcome. A cinematic journey to his roots, which not only reveals the life of a musician, but also shows the inner conflicts and human weak of a man who, despite everything, never lost courage. / Der Film ist ein Portrat des legendaren italienischen Sangers, Multiinstrumentalisten Songwriters und Blues-Musikers Zucchero, das exklusives Filmmaterial aus seinen Privatarchiven und seiner Welttournee zeigt und bekannte Wegbegleiter wie Bono, Sting und Andrea Bocelli zu Wort kommen lasst. Sie alle berichten von einem Mann, der sie sowohl als Kunstler als auch als Mensch beeindruckt hat. Die Doku erzahlt von Zuccheros Kindheitserlebnissen, seiner Hartnackigkeit, internationalen Erfolg zu erlangen, seiner Starke und den Jahren der Depression, die er uberwinden musste. Eine filmische Reise zu seinen Wurzeln, die nicht nur das Leben eines Musikers offenbart, sondern auch die inneren Konflikte und menschlichen Schwachen eines Mannes zeigt, der trotz allem niemals den Mut verlor.

programme.title: cultural Monday / kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: Sugar - Vater des Italo -blues / Zucchero - Vater des Italo-Blues
programme.desc: The film is a portrait of the legendary Italian singer, multi-instrumentalist Songwriters and Blues musicians Zucchero, which shows the exclusive footage from its private archives and its world tour and lets know well-known companions such as Bono, Sting and Andrea Bocelli. They all report on a man who impressed them both as an artist and as a human being. The documentary is paid by Zucchero's childhood experiences, its persistence, international success, its strong and the years of depression that he had to overcome. A cinematic journey to his roots, which not only reveals the life of a musician, but also shows the inner conflicts and human weak of a man who, despite everything, never lost courage. / Der Film ist ein Portrat des legendaren italienischen Sangers, Multiinstrumentalisten Songwriters und Blues-Musikers Zucchero, das exklusives Filmmaterial aus seinen Privatarchiven und seiner Welttournee zeigt und bekannte Wegbegleiter wie Bono, Sting und Andrea Bocelli zu Wort kommen lasst. Sie alle berichten von einem Mann, der sie sowohl als Kunstler als auch als Mensch beeindruckt hat. Die Doku erzahlt von Zuccheros Kindheitserlebnissen, seiner Hartnackigkeit, internationalen Erfolg zu erlangen, seiner Starke und den Jahren der Depression, die er uberwinden musste. Eine filmische Reise zu seinen Wurzeln, die nicht nur das Leben eines Musikers offenbart, sondern auch die inneren Konflikte und menschlichen Schwachen eines Mannes zeigt, der trotz allem niemals den Mut verlor.

programme.title: The vulture - friend or enemy / Der Geier - Freund oder Feind
programme.desc: Second part of the gripping crime series with Philipp Hochmair after the novel BUONA NOTTE by Andrea di Stefano. Ex-policeman Lukas Geier (Philipp Hochmair) is involved in a dangerous game when an order murder is looking for his support. Lukas Geier as well as his departure from the police. Then the call of the former Prasident of the Protection of the Constitution, Annemarie Pabst, tears him out of his new everyday routine. The observed contract killer of the surgeon wants to dive into insider information and the exposure of a mole within the police with a new identity. Pabst puts together a team from Geier, his more early school school Rebecca and Franziska Conte. The three should accommodate the surgeons safely without scabbing the mole at the LKA. A daring undertaking. A production of the Network Movie and Graf Film in Koproduktion with the ZDF in cooperation with the ORF / Zweiter Teil der packenden Krimireihe mit Philipp Hochmair nach der Romanvorlage Buona Notte von Andrea di Stefano. Ex-Polizist Lukas Geier (Philipp Hochmair) wird in ein gefahrliches Spiel verwickelt, als ein Auftragsmorder seine Unterstutzung sucht.Seit seinem Abschied von der Polizei gibt sich Lukas Geier ganz der Musik hin. Da reiSSt ihn der Anruf der ehemaligen Prasidentin des Verfassungsschutzes, Annemarie Pabst, aus seiner neuen Alltagsroutine. Der beruchtigte Auftragskiller Der Chirurg will im Tausch gegen Insider-Informationen und die Enttarnung eines Maulwurfs innerhalb der Polizei mit neuer Identitat abtauchen. Pabst stellt ein Team aus Geier, seiner fruheren Schulerin Rebecca und Franziska Conte zusammen. Die drei sollen den Chirurgen sicher unterbringen, ohne den Maulfwurf beim LKA aufzuschrecken. programme.title: Theme / Thema
programme.desc: Abuse in the children's village - if the silence has a system "I was beaten, locked up and humiliated," says Natascha S. her last name did not want to verof. The 35-year-old spent her childhood in S.O.'s children's village in Moosburg in Karnten. A children's village mother hit her so brutally in the face that she blinds her in one eye. In her time in the children's village, she had five different village nuts. One of them says in the "topic" interview: "If I had the leadership of the violence of my colleagues, I was not wanted to be heard." A study shows which gray relates took place in Moosburg from 2008 to 2020. But violence may have been for some children in the children's village of Bitter everyday life decades earlier. Leon Hoffmann -Eastenhof and Savanka Schwarz with an investigative search. Life after the killing run - start of school in the Borg Dreierschutzengasse "Why can I live on? And why are the others dead?" That wonders Sam Askari every day. The 16-year-old just has English lessons when the amocla run enters his class and shoots him in his head. Since then, half of his face has been paralyzed. On June 10th, ten people will be totted in the Borg Dreierschutzengasse in Graz. Your chairs remain empty on the first day of school. "It is a strange start to school. Many of us don't talk about what happened," says Selin Ceylan. How was the start of school for the schools? Leon Hoffmann-Eastenhof has met some of them for the conversation. She wears a cochlea implant and works as a Horgerateakustiker in Linz. Nevertheless, for the daughter of Horender parents, the building language is their mother tongue. It is the language in which she dreams and seals. During the ORF casting "Make yourself visible" she performed with her building poetry. The Horende Wiener Branislav Zdravkovic is the translator for his heavy -wing mother Olgica Gruber in everyday life. Be it at hand or when a new kitchen is bought. The son is always there. Only since September 1, 2005, the Austrian building language has been recognized as an own language of a non-ethnic minority. For 8,000 to 10,000 people, it is the first language. It has its own grammar and her own poetry. There are still too few interpreters: inside and educational offers. A report by Andrea Poschmaier and Pia Bichara. / Missbrauch im Kinderdorf - wenn das Schweigen System hat"Ich wurde geschlagen, eingesperrt und erniedrigt", sagt Natascha S. Ihren Nachnamen mochte sie nicht veroffentlichen. Die 35-Jahrige hat ihre Kindheit im S.O.S Kinderdorf in Moosburg in Karnten verbracht. Eine Kinderdorfmutter schlagt sie damals so brutal ins Gesicht, dass sie auf einem Auge erblindet, erzahlt sie. In ihrer Zeit im Kinderdorf hatte sie funf verschiedene Dorfmutter. Eine von ihnen sagt im "Thema"-Interview: "Wenn ich der Leitung von der Gewalt meiner Kolleginnen erzahlt habe, wollte man mir nicht zuhoren." Eine Studie belegt, welche Graueltaten sich in Moosburg von 2008 bis 2020 abgespielt haben. Doch Gewalt durfte schon Jahrzehnte zuvor fur manche Kinder im Kinderdorf bitterer Alltag gewesen sein. Leon Hoffmann-Ostenhof und Savanka Schwarz mit einer Investigativrecherche.Leben nach dem Amoklauf - Schulbeginn im BORG Dreierschutzengasse"Warum darf ich weiterleben? Und warum sind die anderen tot?" Das fragt sich Sam Askari jeden Tag. Der 16-Jahrige hat gerade Englischunterricht, als der Amoklaufer seine Klasse betritt und ihm in den Kopf schieSSt. Seitdem ist eine Halfte seines Gesichts gelahmt. Am 10. Juni werden im BORG Dreierschutzengasse in Graz zehn Menschen getotet. Ihre Stuhle bleiben am ersten Schultag leer. "Es ist ein komischer Schulstart. Viele von uns reden nicht uber das, was passiert ist", sagt Selin Ceylan. Wie war der Schulbeginn fur die Schulerinnen und Schuler? Leon Hoffmann-Ostenhof hat einige von ihnen zum Gesprach getroffen.Muttersprache Gebardensprache - 20 Jahre AnerkennungDie 31-jahrige Anja Burghardt ist seit ihrer Geburt schwerhorig. Sie tragt ein Cochlea-Implantat und arbeitet als Horgerateakustikerin in Linz. Dennoch ist fur die Tochter horender Eltern die Gebardensprache ihre Muttersprache. Es ist die Sprache, in der sie traumt und dichtet. Beim ORF-Casting "Mach dich sichtbar" trat sie mit ihrer Gebarden-Poetry auf. Der horende Wiener Branislav Zdravkovic ist im Alltag der Übersetzer fur seine schwerhorige Mutter Olgica Gruber. Sei es bei Behordengangen oder wenn eine neue Kuche gekauft wird. Immer ist der Sohn mit dabei. Erst seit 1. September 2005 ist die Österreichische Gebardensprache als eigenstandige Sprache einer nicht-ethnischen Minderheit anerkannt. Fur 8.000 bis 10.000 Menschen ist sie die Erstsprache. Sie hat eine eigene Grammatik und eine eigene Poesie. Immer noch gibt es zu wenig Dolmetscher:innen und Bildungsangebote. Eine Reportage von Andrea Poschmaier und Pia Bichara.

programme.title: Gym Boys - Why young men pump / Gym Boys - Warum junge Manner pumpen
programme.desc: "Hubsche people just have it easier in life," says Moritz (15). When he posted a video of his body on social media for the first time, he is thirteen years old. It costs him overcoming, because Moritz feels much too chubby, he is bullied at school. And many comments under the video are also bose, but posts and poses belong to many gym boys. Moritz makes a decision: the bacon rolls have to go away, muscles have to be found. He trains iron in the Gym six times a week, tracks down his calories and radically changes his food. Today Moritz has a six -pack and around 25,000 followers on Instagram - but he wants a lot more: followers and muscles. Does the path to the new man'sity go through the gym forcly today? Do more muscles mean more recognition automatically? Are no longer a leek or chubby? The report has been immersed in the life of funf young men for almost a year, who have to find their way between the children's room, Instagram and weight bench. / "Hubsche Menschen haben es einfach leichter im Leben", sagt Moritz (15). Als er zum ersten Mal ein Video von seinem Korper auf Social Media postet, ist er dreizehn Jahre alt. Es kostet ihn Überwindung, denn Moritz empfindet sich als viel zu pummelig, in der Schule wird er gemobbt. Und auch viele Kommentare unter dem Video sind bose, aber posten und posen gehort fur viele Gym Boys dazu. Moritz fasst einen Entschluss: Die Speckrollchen mussen weg, Muskeln mussen her. Sechsmal in der Woche trainiert er eisern im Gym, trackt seine Kalorien und stellt seine Ernahrung radikal um. Heute hat Moritz ein Sixpack und rund 25.000 Follower auf Instagram - aber er will noch viel mehr: Follower und Muskeln. Fuhrt der Weg zur neuen Mannlichkeit heute zwanglaufig durchs Gym? Bedeuten mehr Muskeln, automatisch mehr Anerkennung? Durfen Burschen nicht mehr Lauch sein oder pummelig? Die Reportage ist fast ein Jahr lang in das Leben von funf jungen Mannern eingetaucht, die zwischen Kinderzimmer, Instagram und Hantelbank ihren Weg finden mussen zu einem stimmigen Korpergefuhl und ihrer mannlichen Identitat.

programme.title: Meryn's consulting room / MERYNS sprechzimmer
programme.sub-title: Mut zum Reden - mentale Gesundheit als Lebensmittel
programme.desc: In our society, often only the smiling mask of perfection - but behind some faces there are heavy loads. Whether children, adolescents, adults or seniors - everyone can be faced with psychological stress. The pressure of being perfect, the fear of the future - these challenges affect all age groups and can reach deep into the soul. In Meryn's consulting room, we are talking openly about the most urgent topics of our time: bullying, eating, depression, fears and even suicidality. Our guest, experts, affected people and members share their experiences and provide insights into the diverse challenges that people of all ages meet. But it is not just about creation, it's also about encouraging and practical tips: exercises, routines and impulses that can help in everyday life - whether with children, young people or adults. We also give valuable tips for parents, teachers, nurses and everyone who accompanies people - so that mental health becomes as independent as corperhygiene. Because: A society in which mental health is openly addressed and understood is a stronger society. In Meryn's consulting room, Siegfried Meryn discusses together with: Christina Dietscher, head of the department for non -proportionable diseases, mental health and pension medicine in the Federal Ministry for Social Affairs, Health, Care and Consumer Protection, Barbara Haid, Prasident of the Easternreichische Psychotherapy and Golli Marboe, initiator of the "Mental Health Days", media expert and author / In unserer Gesellschaft zahlt oft nur die lachelnde Maske der Perfektion - doch hinter manchen Gesichtern verbergen sich schwere Lasten. Ob Kinder, Jugendliche, Erwachsene oder Senioren - jeder kann mit psychischen Belastungen konfrontiert sein. Der Druck, perfekt zu sein, die Angst vor der Zukunft - diese Herausforderungen betreffen alle Altersgruppen und konnen tief in die Seele greifen. In Meryns Sprechzimmer reden wir offen uber die drangendsten Themen unserer Zeit: Mobbing, Essstorungen, Depressionen, Ängste und sogar Suizidalitat. Unsere Gaste, Expertinnen, Betroffene und Angehorige, teilen ihre Erfahrungen und geben Einblicke in die vielfaltigen Herausforderungen, denen Menschen jeden Alters begegnen. Doch es geht nicht nur um Aufklarung, es geht auch ums Mut machen und praktische Tipps: Übungen, Routinen und Impulse, die im Alltag helfen konnen - egal ob bei Kindern, Jugendlichen oder Erwachsenen. AuSSerdem geben wir wertvolle Tipps fur Eltern, Lehrer, Pflegekrafte und alle, die Menschen begleiten - damit mentale Gesundheit so selbstverstandlich wird wie Korperhygiene. Denn: Eine Gesellschaft, in der psychische Gesundheit offen angesprochen und unterstutzt wird, ist eine starkere Gesellschaft.Siegfried Meryn diskutiert dazu in MERYNS sprechzimmer zusammen mit: Christina Dietscher, Leiterin der Abteilung fur nicht ubertragbare Erkrankungen, psychische Gesundheit und Altersmedizin im Bundesministerium fur Soziales, Gesundheit, Pflege und Konsumentenschutz, Barbara Haid, Prasidentin des Verbandes der osterreichischen Psychotherapeutinnen sowie Golli Marboe, Initiator der "Mental Health Days", Medienexperte und Buchautor

programme.title: Meeting point medicine / treffpunkt medizin
programme.desc: This "Meeting point Medicine" production immerse yourself deeply into the moving life stories of people who have found back into life and to joy after crises and stroke of fate. Supported by the earnings, emotions and knowledge of the protagonist: Inside, the film shows the broad palette of human experiences and at the same time the viewers invited to self -reflection: What is the meaning for me for me and how do my thoughts influence my well -being? On their journey through the wide land of the soul, the affected people suffer very different ways. With a simplic view, the film illuminates the diverse aspects of pastoral care and the places where it takes shape - be it within the familiar family, in spiritual space such as the church or supporting organizations. The basic question arises based on life routes and flows - what is our soul? And what proportion does it have in our health. For a deeper understanding, psychiatrist Michael Musalek, the theologian Paul Zulehner as well as the psychotherapist and theologian Rotraud A. Perner the functions of pastoral care and at the same time dedicate attention to the deep emotional complexity of humans. / Diese "treffpunkt medizin"-Produktion taucht tief in die bewegenden Lebensgeschichten von Menschen ein, die nach Krisen und Schicksalsschlagen wieder zuruck ins Leben und zur Freude gefunden haben. Getragen von den Erzahlungen, Emotionen und Erkenntnissen der Protagonist:innen zeigt der Film die breite Palette menschlicher Erfahrungen und ladt zugleich die Zuseherinnen und Zuseher zur Selbstreflexion ein: Welche Bedeutung hat Seelsorge fur mich und wie beeinflussen meine Gedanken mein Wohlbefinden? Auf ihrer Reise durch das weite Land der Seele eroffnen sich den Betroffenen ganz unterschiedliche Wege. Mit einem einfuhlsamen Blick beleuchtet der Film die vielfaltigen Aspekte der Seelsorge und die Orte, an denen sie Gestalt annimmt - sei es innerhalb der vertrauten Familie, in spirituellen Raumen wie der Kirche oder unterstutzenden Organisationen. Anhand von Lebenswegen und Schauplatzen stellt sich die grundlegende Frage - was ist eigentlich unsere Seele? Und welchen Anteil hat sie an unserer Gesundheit. Fur ein tieferes Verstandnis erlautern u.a. der Psychiater Michael Musalek, der Theologe Paul Zulehner sowie die Psychotherapeutin und Theologin Rotraud A. Perner die Funktionen der Seelsorge und widmen gleichzeitig der tiefen emotionalen Komplexitat des Menschen Aufmerksamkeit.

programme.title: Die Protein-Luge / Die Protein-Luge
programme.desc: No matter whether yogurt, pizza or energy drink - food with many proteins are trendy. Packed black and often pretended by fitness influencers, they are advertised as part of a healthy lifestyle. The products are particularly well received by the body -conscious young generation. Many promise to lose weight or even build muscle without sport. A billion-dollar wing for industry, because extra protein brings extra margin. Extra rip-off, say consumer protection. Because added protein, such as whey protein, is not only highly processed, but also a by -product from the gas production. A residual protein that is sold expensive as a healthy additive. Carnty scientists and doctors also warn of too much protein. Because energy that the body does not need is stored as fat. The medical journalist Bernhard Hain shows what proteins can and what not. / Egal ob Joghurt, Pizza oder Energy-Drink - Lebensmittel mit vielen Proteinen liegen im Trend. Schwarz verpackt und oft von Fitness-Influencern prasentiert, werden sie als Teil eines gesunden Lebensstils beworben. Besonders bei der korperbewussten jungen Generation kommen die Produkte gut an. Viele versprechen sich davon abzunehmen oder gar Muskeln ohne Sport aufzubauen. Ein Milliarden-Geschaft fur die Industrie, denn Extra-Protein bringt Extra-Marge. Extra-Abzocke, sagen Konsumentenschutzer. Denn zugesetztes Protein, wie etwa MolkeneiweiSS, ist nicht nur hochverarbeitet, sondern auch ein Nebenprodukt aus der Kaseherstellung. Ein ResteiweiSS, das als gesunder Zusatzstoff teuer verkauft wird. Auch Ernahrungswissenschaftler und Mediziner warnen vor einem Zuviel an EiweiSS. Denn Energie, die der Korper nicht braucht, lagert er als Fett ein. Der Medizinjournalist Bernhard Hain zeigt, was Proteine konnen und was nicht.

programme.title: Nelson Muller - the protein compass / Nelson Muller - der EiweiSS-Kompass
programme.desc: Nelson Muller gets to the bottom of a notice legend: an egg every day - that's good for health. What about this advice? In a laying hens operation, the cook clarifies whether eggs are really suitable as a daily protein source. Today we use most proteins about animal foods. However, this increasingly burdens the environment. New fish farms should be the solution. Nelson Muller does not find it on the North Sea, but in the Alps. The star chef in Switzerland shows how modern fish farming could look like in the future and whether it is really more sustainable. The alternative to meat, fish and milk are vegetable proteins. Soy in particular is considered to be particularly protein -rich - it is not for nothing that meat replacement is often from the exotic bean. But are soy foods really the way to environmentally friendly food? And how does simple beans become sliced, minced meat and sausage? Nelson Muller shows why soy is so diverse. / Nelson Muller geht einer Ernahrungslegende auf den Grund: Jeden Tag ein Ei - das ist gut fur die Gesundheit. Was ist dran an diesem Ratschlag? In einem Legehennen-Betrieb klart der Koch, ob Eier wirklich als tagliche Proteinquelle taugen. Heute nehmen wir die meisten Proteine uber tierische Lebensmittel zu uns. Das belastet jedoch zunehmend die Umwelt. Neuartige Fischzuchten sollen die Losung sein. Die findet Nelson Muller aber nicht etwa an der Nordsee, sondern in den Alpen. Wie moderne Fischzucht in der Zukunft aussehen konnte und ob sie wirklich nachhaltiger ist, zeigt der Sternekoch in der Schweiz. Die Alternative zu Fleisch, Fisch und Milch sind pflanzliche Proteine. Vor allem Soja gilt als besonders proteinreich - nicht umsonst besteht Fleischersatz haufig aus der exotischen Bohne. Aber sind Lebensmittel aus Soja wirklich der Weg zu einer umweltfreundlichen Ernahrung? Und wie wird aus einfachen Bohnen Geschnetzeltes, Hackfleisch und Wurst? Nelson Muller zeigt, warum Soja so vielfaltig ist.

Fur ein tieferes Verstandnis erlautern u.a. der Psychiater Michael Musalek, der Theologe Paul Zulehner sowie die Psychotherapeutin und Theologin Rotraud A. Perner die Funktionen der Seelsorge und widmen gleichzeitig der tiefen emotionalen Komplexitat des Menschen Aufmerksamkeit.

programme.title: Die Protein-Luge / Die Protein-Luge
programme.desc: No matter whether yogurt, pizza or energy drink - food with many proteins are trendy. programme.title: Beyond guilt / Jenseits von Schuld
programme.desc: Free TV premiere "Beyond guilt" does the history of a pair of parents whose child became murder. Do you even love your child in the face of this unforgivable guilt? Can you ever stop loving your child as a parents? Can they be a family and take your life as a couple? Ulla and Didi Hogel have come to educate their son with love and reason. Nothing in his childhood and family life indicated that one day he became a serial mider. Niels Hogel probably killed more than 100 people as a nurse and was convicted of 85 murders. An unprecedented case in German crime history. From one day to the next day, her son Uber Ulla and Didi Hogel broke out and has inevitably linked her life with his deeds since then. Even after years, the same questions rotate in their heads again and again, because no answer is enough to find peace. The events during the shooting also do not allow prostration: there is a new process that is directed against the possibility this time. Again everything is in the news, again in the newspapers, entire TV series are done about their son. programme.title: Update Uberfallig. How digital is the economy? / Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?
programme.desc: Cover economy, radiohole, outdated software - many medium -sized companies still get problems in digitization in Germany. What is it? But many companies suffer from slow internet, employees have to convey digital know -how - and at the same time face expensive investments. Who prevents progress - and what had to be done for a long time so that Germany's economic engine does not stutter? In the "WISO" documentary "update. ZDF economic expert Florian Neuhann goes to the causes of digital standstill on the basis. Is the main problem in politics? A clear digital strategy was missing for many years. It was only in May this year that the Federal Ministry for Digital was created under the new government - with Karsten Wildberger (CDU) as the first digital minister. A step with symbolic power, but are new tarpaulin and promise? Florian Neuhann meets the minister and investigates whether the digital departure really succeeds - or threatens to fail again on old structures. Too often it said in the past: "We have always done it that way." But rethinking is increasingly taking place - at least since Corona pandemic, medium -sized companies are increasingly investing in digital projects. In 2024 it was almost 32 billion euros. However, large companies in particular benefit. Smaller companies often remain back - they lack resources, personnel and financial planning security to really implement digital projects. The film by Anja Kollruss and Kim Uhlich shows how medium -sized companies are between departure and wait. They accompany companies that feel step forward - and those that are already in the middle of change. The same question arises between technical hurrets, legal uncertainties and limited resources: What does it take so that digitization does not stay a project for a long time - but really arrives in everyday life? In addition to a conversation with Federal Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger, ZDF journalist Florian Neuhann meets this film by manager Julia Jakel, digital expert Aya Jaff and Andrea Thoma-Bock from the "Initiative Zukunftwirtschaft Germany". / Zettelwirtschaft, Funklocher, veraltete Software - viele mittelstandische Unternehmen kampfen in Deutschland noch immer mit Problemen bei der Digitalisierung. Woran liegts?Dabei gelten gerade sie als Ruckgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft. Doch viele Betriebe leiden unter langsamem Internet, mussen Mitarbeitenden digitales Know-how vermitteln - und stehen gleichzeitig vor teuren Investitionen.Warum schreitet die Digitalisierung im Mittelstand so zah voran? Wer verhindert den Fortschritt - und was hatte langst geschehen sein mussen, damit Deutschlands Wirtschaftsmotor nicht ins Stottern kommt? In der "WISO"-Doku "Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?" geht ZDF-Wirtschaftsexperte Florian Neuhann den Ursachen des digitalen Stillstands auf den Grund.Liegt das Hauptproblem in der Politik? Viele Jahre fehlte eine klare Digitalstrategie. Erst im Mai diesen Jahres wurde unter der neuen Regierung das Bundesministerium fur Digitales geschaffen - mit Karsten Wildberger (CDU) als erstem Digitalminister uberhaupt. Ein Schritt mit Symbolkraft, aber reichen neue Plane und Versprechen aus? Florian Neuhann trifft den Minister und geht der Frage nach, ob der digitale Aufbruch nun wirklich gelingt - oder wieder an alten Strukturen zu scheitern droht.Auch viele Unternehmen mussen sich fragen, welchen Anteil sie selbst am schleppenden Tempo haben. Zu oft hieSS es in der Vergangenheit: "Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht." Doch ein Umdenken findet zunehmend statt - spatestens seit der Corona-Pandemie investieren mittelstandische Unternehmen immer mehr in digitale Projekte. 2024 waren es knapp 32 Milliarden Euro. Allerdings profitieren vor allem groSSere Betriebe. Kleinere Unternehmen bleiben oft zuruck - ihnen fehlt es an Ressourcen, Personal und finanzieller Planungssicherheit, um digitale Vorhaben wirklich umzusetzen.Der Film von Anja KollruSS und Kim Uhlich zeigt, wie Mittelstandler zwischen Aufbruch und Abwarten stehen. Sie begleiten Unternehmen, die sich Schritt fur Schritt voran tasten - und solche, die schon mitten im Wandel stecken. Zwischen technischen Hurden, rechtlichen Unsicherheiten und begrenzten Ressourcen stellt sich immer wieder die gleiche Frage: Was braucht es, damit Digitalisierung nicht langer ein Projekt bleibt - sondern wirklich im Alltag ankommt?Die "WISO"-Dokumentation erklart, warum Digitalisierung im deutschen Mittelstand Chance und Herausforderung zugleich bedeutet. Neben einem Gesprach mit dem Bundesdigitalminister Karsten Wildberger trifft ZDF-Journalist Florian Neuhann fur diesen Film die Managerin Julia Jakel, die Digitalexpertin Aya Jaff und Andrea Thoma-Bock von der "Initiative Zukunft Wirtschaft Deutschland".

programme.desc: Episode: The rich to pay. As Minister of Finance in 1921, tycoon Andrew Melon developed the theory of wealth of wealth down. Πολλοί ασθενείς στηρίζουν στην έρευνα τις ελπίδες τους για την ανάπτυξη θεραπειών.

programme.desc: Episode: The end of a gang. With his release in 1992, Francis Mariani becomes a rally driver. His colleague, Risar Kazanova, deals with the world of football. Ο κολλητός του, Ρισάρ Καζανοβά ασχολείται με τον κόσμο του ποδοσφαίρου. Παράλληλα με τις αθλητικές τους δραστηριότητες, παραμένουν ενεργά μέλη της La Brise de Mer.

programme.title: The secrets of the enchanted K1 E6 (E) Forestry / Τα Μυστικά των Μαγεμένων Δασών Κ1 Ε6 (Ε)

Παρακολουθήστε έντομα που συνεργάζονται με φυτά για να επιβιώσουν και ανακαλύψτε τον χημικό πόλεμο που μαίνεται στη φύση.

programme.title: Day with color (e) / Μέρα με Χρώμα (Ε)
programme.desc: Informative magazine with emphasis on culture, sciences, environment and entrepreneurship. Με απευθείας συνδέσεις, προσκεκλημένους και ρεπορτάζ, η εκπομπή αναδεικνύει θέματα που απασχολούν τους πολίτες της Θεσσαλονίκης.

programme.title: Perimeter (e) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: An informational show that focuses daily on the news and on specific issues, in concentric circles, with a focus on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: The vineyards of the world E6 (e) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: A trip to the beginning of the vineyard. Here the wine is sacred! At the foot of the Grand Caucasus, Georgia has a secret of thousands of years, which is trying to reveal to the world. Vineyards and wine are said to have started here six thousand years ago. / Επεισόδιο: Ένα Ταξίδι στις Απαρχές του Αμπελιού. Εδώ το κρασί είναι ιερό! Στους πρόποδες του Μεγάλου Καυκάσου, η Γεωργία διατηρεί ένα μυστικό χιλιάδων ετών, το οποίο προσπαθεί να αποκαλύψει στον κόσμο. Τα αμπέλια και το κρασί λέγεται ότι ξεκίνησαν εδώ πριν από έξι χιλιάδες χρόνια.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 316 / MMA UFC 316
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Hoffenheim - B. Munich, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Hoffenheim - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: Basbaritonist Juan Vasle, born in Argentina, obtained a singing education at the opera school of the famous Colon Theater in Argentina, where he later performed as an opera soloist. Kasneje se je preselil v Slovenijo in postal član SNG Opera in balet Ljubljana, kjer je ustvaril okoli 50 opernih vlog. Argentinska in južnoameriška glasba sta železni repertoar v Vasletovih koncertnih sporedih, v posnetku tokratnega koncerta s skupino Opus Cuatro pa je predstavil poleg južnoameriške glasbe tudi slovensko narodno pesem.

programme.title: Widows / Viudes
programme.desc: Four women with nothing in common, except the debt inherited by the criminal activities of their deceased husbands, decide to take the reins of their destination and conspire to force a future with their own rules. On this occasion, the filmmaker moves the action of the London from the early 80s to the contemporary Chicago to tell a story about four women of different levels - racial, social and economic - that join forces to achieve a common goal. / Cuatro mujeres sin nada en común, excepto la deuda heredada por las actividades criminales de sus difuntos maridos, deciden tomar las riendas de su destino y conspiran para forjarse un futuro con sus propias reglas.Cinco años despues de ganar el Oscar con 12 años de esclavitud, Steve McQueen estreno este thriller dramático basado en la serie de television británica de 1983 Las viudas. En esta ocasion, el realizador traslada la accion del Londres de principios de los 80 al Chicago contemporáneo para narrar una historia sobre cuatro mujeres de distintos estamentos -racial, social y economico- que unen fuerzas para conseguir un objetivo común.

programme.title: Dark water / Aigues fosques
programme.desc: An Ohio environmental lawyer embarks on a trial against a chemical company that is contaminating the drinking water of a small city.In 1998, lawyer Robert Bilott received the call from a farmer whose cattle had begun to die in strange circumstances. Two years later, man made one of the most transcendental decisions of his life: to sue the almighty company Dupont, of which he suspected that he was the cause of these deaths. Bilott ended up uncovering a contamination case that covered several decades and became a reference for a society increasingly concerned about ecology. / Un abogado ambientalista de Ohio se embarca en un juicio contra una empresa química que está contaminando el agua potable de una pequeña ciudad.En 1998, el abogado Robert Bilott recibio la llamada de un granjero cuyo ganado había empezado a morir en extrañas circunstancias. Dos años despues, el hombre tomo una de las decisiones más trascendentales de su vida: demandar a la todopoderosa empresa DuPont, de la que sospechaba que era la causante de dichas muertes. Bilott acabo destapando un caso de contaminacion que abarcaba varias decadas y se convirtio en un referente para una sociedad cada vez más preocupada por la ecología.
